تتعجرفين (form IIq)
# تَتَعَجْرَفِينَ (tataʕajrafīna) /ta.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# تُتَعَجْرَفِينَ (tutaʕajrafīna) /tu.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
